full_judgment:
Nazmun Ara Sultana, J. This Civil petition for leave to appeal, at the instance of the People's Republic of Bangladesh represented by the Deputy Commissioner, Dhaka and others, is directed against the judgment and order dated 24.08.2009 passed by the High Court Division in First Appeal No. 50 of 2005 disposing of the appeal sending the suit on remand to the trial court with direction to dispose of the suit within 6(six) months from the date of receipt of that judgment and order. The respondents herein, as plaintiffs, instituted Title Suit No. 456 of 2000 in the court of the learned Joint District Judge, 2nd Court, Dhaka for declaration of title and rectification of record of right in respect of 5.275 acres of land out of 10.55 acres of land mentioned in the schedule of the plaint declaring the same as non-resident and vested property. The present defendant-petitioners appeared in the suit and contested by filing written statement. The learned Joint District Judge, 2nd Court, Dhaka, on consideration of the evidence adduced by both the parties, dismissed the suit by the judgment and decree dated 03.01.2005. 

 2. Being aggrieved by that judgment and decree of the trial court the plaintiffs filed the above mentioned First Appeal No. 50 of 2005 before the High Court Division. The High Court Division, after hearing the learned Counsel of both the parties, disposed of that first appeal as already stated by the impugned judgment and order. 

 6. It appears that the learned Deputy Attorney General who appeared in that appeal for the defendant-respondents did not seriously oppose that prayer of the plaintiff-appellants for sending the suit on remand. Rather, he submitted that if the appeal was sent on remand both the parties should be given chance to adduce further evidence. The High Court Division, on consideration of the prayer of the plaintiff-appellants and also the submission of the learned Deputy Attorney General for the defendant-respondents allowed that application and consequently disposed of the appeal sending back the suit on remand to the trial court by setting aside the impugned judgment and decree of the trial court and giving direction to the trial court to dispose of the suit afresh within 6(six) months from the date of receipt of that judgment and order.
